steps: Cook the onion dry in a pot for thirty minutes over medium heat, stirring, until it becomes a dark paste.
Pour in the oil, add the garlic and ginger and cook three minutes.
Stir in the berbere and tomato paste and fry five minutes: the mixture darkens and turns fragrant.
Add the lentils, pour in the water and simmer twenty-five minutes, stirring, until the lentils fall apart.
Season at the end, cook it down to a porridge-thick stew and serve with injera or flatbread.
